prompts.floor: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: cinematic pixel-art background for PokéWorld, 16:9 landscape. Reference image: the previously shown tropical island Mew mural is a STYLE reference only. Create a different camera shot deep INSIDE the same lush tropical rainforest, at ground level. Dense layered emerald and blue-green foliage, enormous old tree trunks left and right and several middle-distance trunks, tangled roots, hanging vines, fern clusters, small humid rock pools. A winding open mossy forest floor leaves a visible horizontal corridor across the middle for an animated small creature to run/fly across later. Far jungle softly lit teal, close foliage dark emerald. Detailed hand-crafted 16-bit Pokémon Emerald style, crisp square pixels and stepped outlines, limited colors per material. Wide cinematic composition with depth, clear silhouettes and tasteful contrast, mysterious but readable. No Pokémon, no people, no creature silhouette, no text, no interface, no photographic blur, no smooth 3D. Keep the center route unobstructed so a separately animated shadow can cross it.
prompts.canopy: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: second jungle cinematic background for PokéWorld, 16:9 landscape. Same lush tropical island style as the shown Mew mural, but a DISTINCT HIGH CANOPY camera shot. Look diagonally across massive mossy branches and intertwined giant trees, thin hanging lianas, dense bright tropical treetops, a glimpse of a winding turquoise river far below between tree trunks, warm sunlight filtered through leaves. Main thick broad branches form a visible zigzag route from left to upper right across the middle, with open spaces between them for an animated shadow creature to dart between later. Near dark leafy silhouettes frame the upper corners; distant foliage turquoise. Refined 16-bit pixel art like Pokémon Emerald, sharp square pixels, stepped outlines, restrained palettes and rich layered scenery, consistent scale and cinematic 16:9 framing. Empty environment: no creatures, no people, no text, no HUD, no photorealism, no smooth gradients.
prompts.clearing: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final reveal background for a Mew cinematic in PokéWorld, 16:9 landscape. Same lush tropical pixel-art world as the reference island mural. View from a dark forest path opening into a SECRET SUNLIT JUNGLE CLEARING. A beautiful empty round mossy grass clearing centered in the middle distance, a few small pink and cream flowers around its perimeter, a still shallow turquoise pond behind it, huge leafy rainforest trees surrounding it, arching branches forming a natural frame. Gentle golden sunbeams from upper right reach the middle, distant mist is pale mint, nearer plants dark blue-green. The focal point (center x50%, y55%) and ground under it must remain EMPTY for a separate floating Mew sprite, with no rock, statue or animal there. Foreground framing leaves on side edges; bottom central moss path leads inward. Detailed crisp 16-bit Pokémon Emerald style pixel art, stepped outlines, square pixels, clear restrained color clusters, magical serene atmosphere. No creatures, no people, no mural, no laboratory, no text or interface, no smooth painted blur.
